ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the base surface, contrasted by high-intensity (white) pixels resulting from water spray and high-contrast beige/white clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-toned pigmentation covering both lobes; localized high-contrast beige/off-white contiguous clusters mapped to the extreme distal coordinates of the fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center of the lobes with deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge of both lobes; the right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude jagged peaks along its medial-superior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory extending from the central peduncle transition to the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of beige and white pixels located at the extreme left and right lateral tips (consistent with barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the upper-medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustations and associated surface irregularities located at both distal lobe tips.
